about: Days on which the engine deliberately differs from Missale Meum on the principal celebration, class or colour, 1962-2100. Each cites the General Rubrics (1960). The SSPX Ordo (ordo.fsspx.org), consulted 2026-11-09 as a development-time cross-check, agrees with the engine on every one.

days.why: The vigil is omitted because its feast is transferred that year (the Sacred Heart falls on the feast). Missale Meum keeps the vigil.

When the Annunciation is transferred after Easter its rightful place is the Monday after Low Sunday; St. Joseph, also transferred, takes the next free day. Missale Meum gives the Monday to St. Joseph.

When the Annunciation is transferred after Easter its rightful place is the Monday after Low Sunday; St. Joseph, also transferred, takes the next free day. Missale Meum gives the Monday to St. Joseph.
In a leap year this Saturday is a 4th class feria once St. Matthias or St. Gabriel moves to the next day, so it is Our Lady on Saturday. Missale Meum leaves the feria.
